notes: Water years run Oct 1 to Sep 30. Values are cumulative rainfall since Oct 1, by day of the water year.
Days are PST, as reported by the district.
Averages use complete water years from the last 15 (at least 95% of days with data). The current water year is never included.
Feb 29 in years without one repeats Feb 28's total.
Suspected outages are dry spells when the other gauges clearly got rain; those days count as missing.
